component.name: Jurassic Park: Trespasser Recompiled
component.summary: Native PC port of Jurassic Park: Trespasser, bring your own disc

description.p: An unofficial native x86-64 PC port of Jurassic Park: Trespasser. The game's own code runs on the PC through a replacement for the Windows system libraries, with a Vulkan renderer and a software fallback.

No game files are included. Import your own Trespasser disc image (.iso), or the game you already have on disk, from the launcher: English 1.0.116 (UK or US disc), Russian (Fargus), Spanish or Brazilian Portuguese. The version is recognised from its files, never from the file name.

ul.li: Launcher with game import, graphics, controls and gameplay settings
Vulkan renderer and a software fallback that needs no GPU driver
Widescreen, field of view, anti-aliasing, texture filtering and frame rate options
Controller, keyboard and mouse, with Xbox and PlayStation button prompts
Community custom levels, saves per game version, a Bug Report page and a built-in updater

description.p: The same AppImage is intended for desktop Linux and the Steam Deck; Steam Deck hardware validation is still pending.
